45091.summary: The class explores God's manifestation through Moses's request to see God's glory in Exodus 33-34, emphasizing God's attributes of mercy, grace, and forgiveness. It connects these attributes to the Christian's duty to develop similar characteristics and live a godly life.

45092.summary: The class explores the significance of God's name, Yahweh, as revealed to Moses at the burning bush, emphasizing its importance in God's plan and purpose. It connects this revelation to Jesus' manifestation of God's name through his life, death, and resurrection, highlighting the role of redemption in fulfilling God's primary purpose of manifesting his glory.

45093.summary: The class explores God's identity as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, emphasizing the significance of these patriarchs and the promises made to them. It discusses the divine attributes and the concept of God as a father, linking this to the faithful and the spiritual descendants of these patriarchs.
